title: Cut-off Jastrow Factors and Spectral Barron Regularity of Coulombic Electronic Wave Functions
summary: We study the spectral Barron regularity of Coulombic electronic eigenfunctions after extraction of a cut-off Jastrow factor. Let \(H=-Δ+V\) be an \(N\)-electron Coulomb Hamiltonian with clamped nuclei, and let \(ψ\) be an eigenfunction associated with a discrete eigenvalue below the bottom of the essential spectrum.
